metadata.title: November 4, 2011 - For Good Measure
metadata.author: by Randolph Ross / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: 1960s TV show set in the Everglades
Measure of half a large intestine?
Measure of a small amount of mouthwash?
Rosters of the rich and famous
Measures of the time it takes to slip on a peel and hit the pavement?

Take care of passengers with small children, say
Measure of the force of falling fruit?
